fields.label: Prompt
notes: Seedance recommends prompts under 1000 words.

fields.label: Images
notes: Use role first_frame, last_frame, or reference_image.
Seedance 2.5 supports up to 30 images.

fields.label: Videos
notes: Use role reference_video. Seedance 2.5 supports up to 10 videos.
The current shared API documentation limits total reference-video duration to 15 seconds.

fields.label: Audio
notes: Use role reference_audio. Seedance 2.5 supports up to 10 audio files.
Audio attachments cannot be submitted without an image or video attachment.
The current shared API documentation limits total reference-audio duration to 15 seconds.

fields.label: Duration
notes: Seedance 2.5 supports integer duration 4-30 seconds, or -1 for adaptive.
